## Developer problem

Who needs this, and what currently prevents them from doing it?

## Smallest useful change

Describe the proposed behavior, an example input/output and how success could
be verified. Explain whether this stays within the simulated refund workflow.

## Alternatives and boundaries

Could existing YAML rules, custom factories or reports solve it? If it needs a
new workflow/provider, describe its tool semantics and authoritative verifier.
